limitations.title: No published price exists for most of these leagues
limitations.detail: Sub-tier LoL (national 2nd/3rd divisions, regional championships, academy leagues) is not listed by Polymarket and is only sporadically listed by sportsbook odds-comparison pages. Where no price exists the row falls back to our own Elo line; where not even that exists it is listed as unresolved.

limitations.title: Some leagues publish too few finished series to rate a team
limitations.detail: The Elo model needs completed, scored series. Leagues with fewer than three verifiable finished series cannot produce a defensible rating for both teams.

limitations.title: Hotspawn's own pick share is excluded on purpose
limitations.detail: The lobby's “X% picked” is a crowd-vote percentage, not a probability, and the brief rules it out as a probability source. It is shown next to our number for comparison only and is never an input.

limitations.title: Roster, patch and veto information is not published for these tiers
limitations.detail: Our own line is a form/strength model. It cannot account for roster swaps, stand-ins or patch swings in amateur leagues, which is why low-sample rows are labelled “very low” confidence rather than being presented as a priced line.
